decisions.reason: Increasing the reader view width does not change NFT-holder eligibility, Lit Protocol gating, ownership checks, or network configuration.
The reader-width change does not alter IPFS storage, the Pinata provider, or the ebook take-down option.
The source changes the ebook reader's book-view width, not the landing page's content or layout.
The reader-width adjustment does not revise any FAQ copy, topic, or consistency rule.
The source does not change About-page content or resolve its existing reward-payout ambiguity.
Changing the reader view width does not affect email delivery, notifications, or confirmation-email contents.
The book-view width refers to the ebook reader and does not change the landing-page cover's size, placement, or cropping.
The visual width of the reader does not alter book access, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket behavior after NFT transfer.
The reader-width adjustment does not change the NFT ebook asset format or unlimited edition supply.
The source does not change email authentication, magic links, or dashboard access.
Although the message separately mentions a mint edge case, the audited source Event only changes book-view width and does not modify no-referral commission allocation.
The reader-width change does not alter SIWE, protected wallet flows, or Transak-created wallet access.
